2608.05230.title: Quality Diversity for Reliable Data Driven Time-Use Optimization
2608.05230.paper_summary: The daily allocation of the finite 24-hour time budget is strongly associated with physical, mental, and cognitive health. While predictive models can estimate the relationship between time-use compositions and health outcomes such as body mass index, life satisfaction, and cognition, most optimization approaches focus only on maximizing expected benefit and do not consider the uncertainty inherent in data-driven prediction. Ignoring uncertainty in health-related decisions can lead to unrealistic time-use recommendations. To address this gap, we introduce an uncertainty quantification Quality Diversity (QD) framework for a more reliable time-use recommendation. Objective functions are derived using compositional data analysis using a large child cohort dataset n > 1000, to capture the relationship between daily activity compositions and multiple health indicators. We develop a new approach that incorporates predictive uncertainty into QD processes and produces more reliable recommendations that balance the expected health benefits with the confidence of the model. We explore the solution space through variable-based and objective-based behavioral representations, revealing diverse high-quality time-use composition and explicit relationships between health outcomes under uncertainty. By embedding uncertainty directly into optimization, our framework shifts the time-use recommendations toward regions of lower uncertainty while preserving high-quality structures for more reliable decision-making in behavioral health.
2608.05230.paper_summary_zh: 每日有限的24小時時間預算的分配與身體、心理和認知健康有著密切的關聯。<lb/>雖然預測模型可以估計時間使用組成與健康結果（如身體質量指數、生活滿意度和認知）之間的關係，但大多數優化方法僅專注於最大化預期效益，而不考慮數據驅動預測中固有的不確定性。<lb/>忽略健康相關決策中的不確定性可能導致不切實際的時間使用建議。<lb/>為了解決這一空白，我們引入了一種不確定性量化的質量多樣性（QD）框架，以提供更可靠的時間使用建議。<lb/>目標函數是使用大型兒童隊列數據集 n > 1000 的組成數據分析推導出來的，以捕捉每日活動組成與多個健康指標之間的關係。<lb/>我們開發了一種新方法，將預測不確定性納入QD過程，並產生更可靠的建議，平衡預期的健康效益與模型的信心。<lb/>我們通過基於變量和基於目標的行為表示探索解決空間，揭示了在不確定性下多樣化的高質量時間使用組成和健康結果之間的明確關係。<lb/>通過將不確定性直接嵌入優化，我們的框架將時間使用建議推向不確定性較低的區域，同時保留高質量結構，以便在行為健康中進行更可靠的決策。
